name: SciQ
description: SciQ is a science question answering benchmark containing crowdsourced science exam questions. Each question has four answer choices including the correct answer and three distractor answers. Questions span topics in physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science, with supporting paragraph context provided for each question.
reputation: Science QA benchmark from crowdsourced exam questions; introduced at BioNLP 2017; commonly used in open LLM evaluation harnesses
notes: Introduced at BioNLP workshop at ACL 2017. 13,679 science questions (11,679 train, 1,000 dev, 1,000 test). Each question comes with a support passage. Questions are generally easier than ARC or OpenBookQA. Used in open-source LLM evaluation harnesses. Largely saturated by modern frontier models.
